{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace DagReduction

inductive Edge where
  | edge (src dst : Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  n : Nat
  edges : List Edge
  deriving Repr

def wellFormed (g : Input) : Prop :=
  g.n ≤ 10 ∧ ∀ e ∈ g.edges, match e with
    | Edge.edge u v => u < g.n ∧ v < g.n

def encoded (e : Edge) : Nat :=
  match e with
  | Edge.edge u v => u * 11 + v

def sortedUnique (xs : List Edge) : List Edge :=
  let codes := xs.map encoded
  let uniqueCodes := codes.eraseDups
  let sortedCodes := uniqueCodes.mergeSort (· ≤ ·)
  sortedCodes.map (fun c => Edge.edge (c / 11) (c % 11))

def hasPathFuel (edges : List Edge) (src dst fuel : Nat) : Bool :=
  if fuel = 0 then
    src = dst
  else if src = dst then
    true
  else
    edges.any (fun e => match e with
      | Edge.edge u v => u = src && hasPathFuel edges v dst (fuel - 1))

def hasCycleFuel (g : Input) : Bool :=
  g.edges.any (fun e => match e with
    | Edge.edge u v => hasPathFuel g.edges v u g.n)

def alternatePath (g : Input) (a b : Nat) : Bool :=
  g.edges.any (fun e => match e with
    | Edge.edge u v => u = a && v ≠ b && hasPathFuel g.edges v b (g.n - 1))

def reduction (g : Input) : List Edge :=
  let unique := sortedUnique g.edges
  let kept := unique.filter (fun e => match e with
    | Edge.edge u v => !alternatePath g u v)
  sortedUnique kept

def solve (g : Input) : Except Unit (List Edge) :=
  if hasCycleFuel g then Except.error () else Except.ok (reduction g)

theorem cyclic_returns_null (g : Input) :
    hasCycleFuel g = true → solve g = Except.error () := by sorry

theorem acyclic_returns_sorted_unique_reduction (g : Input) :
    hasCycleFuel g = false → solve g = Except.ok (reduction g) := by sorry

theorem retained_iff_no_alternate_path (g : Input) (u v : Nat) :
    hasCycleFuel g = false →
    (Edge.edge u v ∈ reduction g ↔
      (Edge.edge u v ∈ sortedUnique g.edges ∧ alternatePath g u v = false)) := by sorry

theorem reachability_preserved (g : Input) (u v : Nat) :
    hasCycleFuel g = false →
    (hasPathFuel g.edges u v g.n = true ↔
      hasPathFuel (reduction g) u v g.n = true) := by sorry

theorem no_redundant_edges (g : Input) (u v : Nat) :
    hasCycleFuel g = false → Edge.edge u v ∈ reduction g →
    alternatePath g u v = false := by sorry

theorem output_shape_and_order (g : Input) :
    (hasCycleFuel g = true → solve g = Except.error ()) ∧
    (hasCycleFuel g = false → solve g = Except.ok (sortedUnique (reduction g))) := by sorry

theorem standard_library_purity_model (g : Input) :
    solve g = solve g := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
    (∃ g : Input, wellFormed g ∧ hasCycleFuel g = false) ∧
    (∃ g : Input, wellFormed g ∧ hasCycleFuel g = true) := by sorry
